editor_reconstruction_note: In one frame the blackboard gains a long curved horizon arc, a cluster of three tiny robed figures (wise men) lower-left, and scattered dots incl. one larger black dot upper-right. Stick figure unchanged.
Small round helmet/globe-like object with a short arrow pointing down at it appears on the horizon arc below the large dot at right (identity unreadable at tile scale).
Solid red curved arrow appears from the wise men up-right toward the small object on the arc.
Red dashed looping wiggly path appears from wise men to the object, in addition to the solid red arrow.

Hard cut at 12.79s to full-frame stippled night sky; wise men on a horizon line; red label 'SIRIUS' beside a star. Over 201 frames the sky slides (SIRIUS moves from right to left and exits; a sun outline appears right then upper-middle; stars thin). By f507 (21.13s) the canvas shows a red spiral/coil map with labels 'JERUSALEM' 'BETHLEHEM' 'DEAD SEA' 'To ANTARCTICA' and grey Dead Sea shape. Exact onset of the swap to the map UNRESOLVED (between 19.46s and 21.13s).
Small black bracket on the spiral and label 'WALKING/HALF A DAY' with leader line appear at middle.

Hard cut to three robed wise men (black ink, hats/crown, staffs) centre; speech labels with tails 'AND I WOULD WALK 500 MILES' (left) and 'AND I WOULD WALK 500 MORE' (right); one dot upper-right and faint dots.
Horizon line and sketchy ground hatching strokes appear under the wise men; figures, speech labels and dot unchanged.

Hard cut at 31.0s to black space with grey globe segment and white region; red inward spiral around tiny wise men, red coil at left, tiny figures lower-right. Spiral grows larger over f744-831 (write-on/expansion). At f853 (35.54s) canvas is the blackboard (empty) with stick figure raised arm; cut onset between 34.63s and 35.54s UNRESOLVED.

In one frame the board gains a sun symbol upper-left, a circle (Earth) with tiny wise men on its upper-left edge, a black dashed arrow through the circle to a dot, and label 'SIRIUS' with curved leader.
Red zigzag scribble drawn across the dashed line through the circle over 5 frames, starting at left of circle and extending right toward Sirius dot.
Board diagram replaced in one frame by text: underlined 'CONDITIONS:' then 'IF: STAR IN SKY' 'IF: SUN HAS SET' 'THEN: WALK TOWARDS STAR' (black). Stick figure unchanged.
Red text '#CAN WALK ON WATER' appears below the list.
Hard cut to white canvas with two black dots labelled 'JERUSALEM' (upper) and 'BETHLEHEM' (lower). Board and stick figure gone.
Red solid line drawn from Jerusalem dot leftward then back down-right with arrowhead to Bethlehem over 4 frames (f1124 shows only short stub from Jerusalem).
Cut to map close-up: grey landmass upper-left, Red Sea coastline right, small islands; red zigzag line at top extends down-left over 4 frames.

Cut/zoom-out (onset UNRESOLVED; first frame already full) to globe: grey continents, white ocean, black outline, Africa centre. Red arrowed path grows from Egypt south through Africa then horizontal red loops over southern Africa across 11 frames.
Hard cut to grey satellite-dish PyEphem logo with text 'PyEphem' upper; screen box with 'YEAR: 2025' and sparse star dots; stick figure at laptop and desk lower-left.
Year number replaced by 'YEAR:' with black circled rewind icon (double left triangles); stars become blurred horizontal streaks.
Rewind icon replaced by 'YEAR: 250' with a sharp star field.
Year number replaced again by rewind icon and blurred streaks.
Screen now 'YEAR: ~4BC' with sharp star field and three tiny wise men in black ink at lower-left of the screen.
Hard cut to near-black canvas; wise men as white line drawing standing on a white horizon line lower-left; very faint stars.

In one frame appear glowing comet with long grey tail labelled in white text 'HALLEY'S COMET', a bright four-point star labelled 'SUPERNOVA', and a faint streaking object labelled 'METEOR', each with curved leader arrow.
Red scribble drawn over the supernova star over 5 frames.
Red scribbles drawn over comet head and meteor; then red text 'WRONG TIME' (left of comet) and 'TOO FAST' (near meteor) typed in letter by letter over 18 frames.
Hard cut to white canvas with four stick figures holding books/scrolls/papers (hair bun, plain, dark-haired with scroll, ponytail) each with small label '112 BC!' '4AD!' '32AD' '7BC'.
Hard cut to white canvas: 'JERUSALEM' upper-right dot, 'BETHLEHEM' lower-right dot, red dashed V path with arrowhead already drawn from Jerusalem to Bethlehem.
Red label 'DEC 25' appears at left along the dashed path.
Second red dashed path drawn from Jerusalem to the right then down-left crossing first path then down-right with arrow; red text 'D' then 'DEC X' appears at left over 13 frames.
Third red dashed path drawn near Jerusalem going down-right to the right edge and down-left with arrow; second 'DEC X' label appears at right.
